description: Verkehr is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Baden-Württemberg. Unter dieser Seite finden Sie Datensätze zum Thema Verkehr der Stadt Konstanz. Diese umfassen Informationen zu Infrastruktureinrichtungen und Angeboten verschiedener Verkehrsmittel, darunter motorisierter Individualverkehr, öffentlicher Personennahverkehr und Fernverkehr. Datensätze zum Thema Radverkehr finden Sie hier: Radverkehr Offene Daten Konstanz. Coverage: Open Data Baden-Württemberg. The portal files it under the publisher Open Data Baden-Württemberg. Its tags are __, geo, transport-und-verkehr. It offers 8 resource(s) in APP, ESRI HUB, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
